title: Permutation in String
description:
Given strings s1 and s2, return true if s2 contains a permutation of s1 — a substring with the same letters in any order.

Example 1:
Input: s1 = "ab", s2 = "eidbaooo"
Output: true
Explanation: s2 contains "ba"

Example 2:
Input: s1 = "ab", s2 = "eidboaoo"
Output: false

Constraints:
- 1 ≤ len(s1), len(s2) ≤ 10^4
- Both strings consist of lowercase English letters
idea: A window of length len(s1) slides over s2. Keep the letter counts of s1 and of the window, plus matches — how many of the 26 letters have equal counts. Sliding the window changes only two letters, so matches is updated in O(1). matches == 26 means a permutation is found.
